entries.name: Apache OpenDAL
entries.use_for: One API to access S3, GCS, Azure, filesystems and 50+ storage services
entries.why: Apache project with bindings for many languages; avoids vendor lock-in in storage code.

entries.name: Ceph
entries.use_for: Unified distributed object, block and file storage at scale
entries.why: Proven large-scale open storage with an S3-compatible gateway; LGPL licensed.

license_verified.note: COPYING: core under LGPL-2.1 or LGPL-3, some files BSD/MIT

entries.name: Dropzone
entries.use_for: Add drag-and-drop uploads with previews to any web page without a framework.
entries.why: Long-standing, framework-free uploader with progress bars and chunking.

entries.name: FilePond
entries.use_for: Add a polished drag-and-drop file upload field with image previews.
entries.why: Smooth UX, plugin system for image editing/validation and adapters for React, Vue and Svelte.

entries.name: Flysystem
entries.use_for: Filesystem abstraction for PHP: local, S3, SFTP and more behind one API
entries.why: Powers the Laravel Storage facade; the standard PHP storage layer.

entries.name: formidable
entries.use_for: Parse multipart form data and file uploads in any Node.js server.
entries.why: Streaming, framework-agnostic parser with a long track record and wide usage.

entries.name: Garage
entries.use_for: Run lightweight S3-compatible storage across a few self-hosted machines.
entries.why: Designed for small, geo-distributed clusters on modest hardware; simple to operate (AGPL-3.0).

entries.name: JuiceFS
entries.use_for: POSIX distributed file system on top of object storage and Redis/SQL metadata
entries.why: Mount S3 as a shared, fast filesystem for apps and ML workloads; Apache-2.0.

entries.name: Laravel Media Library
entries.use_for: Associate uploaded files with Eloquent models, with conversions and responsive images
entries.why: The go-to Laravel upload and media package.

entries.name: Multer
entries.use_for: Handle multipart/form-data file uploads in Express apps.
entries.why: The standard Express upload middleware, maintained by the Express team.

entries.name: rclone
entries.use_for: Sync, copy and mount files across 70+ cloud storage providers
entries.why: The Swiss-army knife for cloud storage; also usable as a Go library or via its remote-control HTTP API.

entries.name: react-dropzone
entries.use_for: Add a drag-and-drop file zone to a React app with a hook.
entries.why: Tiny, headless hook-based API that is the go-to dropzone for React.

entries.name: RustFS
entries.use_for: Self-host S3-compatible object storage written in Rust.
entries.why: Apache-2.0 MinIO alternative with a quickly growing community and a web console.

entries.name: SeaweedFS
entries.use_for: Self-host distributed object storage with an S3 API for many small or large files.
entries.why: Mature, fast store for billions of files with S3, FUSE and WebDAV access.

entries.name: Shrine
entries.use_for: Handle file attachments and uploads in Ruby and Rails apps.
entries.why: Modular toolkit with direct-to-S3 uploads, background processing and derivatives.

entries.name: Supabase Storage
entries.use_for: Self-host an S3-compatible storage API with Postgres-backed metadata and row-level security.
entries.why: Powers Supabase Storage; brings Postgres policies to file access and supports resumable uploads.

entries.name: tus-js-client
entries.use_for: Resumable file uploads from browsers and Node using the tus protocol
entries.why: Official tus client pairing with tusd; reliable large uploads that survive network drops.

entries.name: tusd
entries.use_for: Run a server for resumable uploads using the open tus protocol.
entries.why: Reference tus server with S3, GCS and Azure storage backends; pairs with Uppy and tus-js-client.

entries.name: UploadThing
entries.use_for: Type-safe file uploads for full-stack TypeScript apps (Next.js, Remix, etc.)
entries.why: Popular DX-first upload SDK with React components and server routes.

entries.name: Uppy
entries.use_for: Add a modular file uploader with drag and drop, remote sources and resumable uploads.
entries.why: Most complete JS uploader: tus, S3 multipart, Dashboard UI and Companion for Google Drive/Dropbox imports.
